name: AIScan
description: AI visibility auditing for websites. Pay-per-capability via x402 on Base.

flows: direct-transfer (send USDC, retry with tx hash)

check_health.description: Site availability, robots.txt, AI crawler access (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot), sitemap presence

check_llms_txt.description: llms.txt existence and quality check: sections, links, statistics

check_schema.description: Schema.org JSON-LD detection: types found, FAQ schema, Organization schema

check_agent_files.description: openapi.json, ai-plugin.json, x402 payment support detection

check_mcp.description: MCP discoverability: /.well-known/mcp.json, agent.json, MCP Server Card

score_aeo.description: Full AEO (AI Search Visibility) score 0-100 with detailed checks

score_geo.description: Full GEO (Citation Readiness) score 0-100 with detailed checks

score_agent.description: Full Agent Readiness score 0-100 with detailed checks

score_mcp.description: Full MCP Readiness score 0-100, the only scanner that checks this

full_audit.description: Complete audit: all 4 scores (AEO, GEO, Agent, MCP), 80+ checks

generate_llms_txt.description: Generate a ready-to-deploy llms.txt tailored to the site

generate_mcp_json.description: Generate ready-to-deploy mcp.json + agent.json for the site

fix_pack.description: Copy-paste fix instructions for every failed check

generate_skill.description: Generate a ready-to-run SKILL.md fix file that Claude Code and other AI coding agents execute to apply every fix automatically

compare.description: Gap analysis vs a competitor URL: who wins each category and why

full_report.description: Everything: full audit + fix pack + generated llms.txt and mcp.json

visibility_check.description: Brand visibility in AI answers: AIScan runs 30 realistic niche prompts through a frontier AI model - mention rate, share of voice, who gets recommended instead. Params: brand + niche (no url needed)

visibility_vs_competitor.description: Head-to-head brand visibility in AI answers: 30 niche prompts, both brands measured on the same answers - mention rates, share of voice, verdict. Params: brand + competitor_brand + niche (no url needed)

visibility_fix_pack.description: Ready-to-deploy fix materials for weak visibility areas: citable passages, FAQ schema JSON-LD, llms.txt sections. Params: brand + niche + weak_spots array (from a prior visibility_check)
